map.Ma = v/a，a=sqrt(gamma*R*T) 为声速。例：空气 20℃: Ma = v/a, with a=sqrt(gamma*R*T) the speed of sound. Example: air at 20 °C has a ≈ 343 m/s, so v = 686 gives Ma = 2 (supersonic). ...
map.Ma<0.3 近似不可压，0.3-1 亚声速，1-5 超声速，>5 高超声速。: Ma below 0.3 is approximately incompressible, 0.3-1 subsonic, 1-5 supersonic, above 5 hypersonic.
map.Ma>1 出现激波，参数突变。: Above Ma 1 shock waves appear and parameters jump discontinuously.
